checkpoint_origin.verification: Original author Transformer 216 ONNX without conversion or weight changes. SHA256 and author Git blob 82ed6796c50b53d3fc260741dbb676b09ac0084f verified.

deployment.route: Author Transformer inference class, privileged=false, history_len=16, G1_VERSION=5010, HAND=Default, 50Hz.
deployment.reference_preprocessing: Causal author EMA alpha0.8 with quaternion sign continuity and normalization, then author world-frame finite-difference qvel and5010 FK. Only policy input is filtered; scoring still uses unmodified canonical reference.
deployment.reference_window: Current filtered reference supplies XY/yaw error; next filtered reference supplies joints,height,gravity,cvel. Endpoints reuse the final filtered feature rather than applying repeated EMA updates.
deployment.kinematics: assets/g1_5010_kinematics.xml derives from pinned author XML by removing mesh assets/geoms only. All30 explicit inertials and body/joint transforms preserved. Used for reference features only, never simulation or scoring.
deployment.reset: Fresh reference filter and zero last action for each clip. Author history initialization repeats the first measured observation across all 16 slots, then shifts oldest to newest.
deployment.output: Author gain/scaling constants without decimal truncation; float32 motor-target assignment; no additional action clipping. Native PD torque and canonical actuator limits remain kernel-owned.
deployment.legacy: This Transformer checkpoint is separate from the 264 MLP. No scores or trajectories are inherited from another checkpoint.
deployment.history: Sixteen 136D frames in oldest-to-newest order. This length follows the released ONNX shape, overriding the incompatible author script default of four frames.

checkpoint_architecture: Original 216_trans ONNX: 16-frame history of 136D observations, 29-action output. The artifact input requires 16 frames; the author Transformer class accepts this history length explicitly. See validation/checkpoint-graph.json.
